note: A `for generate` counting down with `i > 0`, marking every place the bus changes value between adjacent bits. End-to-end cover for the `op_gt` half of hif-core#24, fixed by hif-core 5603a2a: the expansion range started at the condition bound rather than at the lowest value the index reaches, so a loop running i = 7 down to 1 elaborated as i = 6 down to 0 - the top lane left with no driver and every other lane reading one bit too low. The step is one, which is the point: hif-core#24 was reported as a non-unit-step defect and this half was wrong at every step, so for_generate_strided does not cover it. Behavioural because the structural pipeline cannot see it - the regenerated design reparses cleanly whichever iterations it was given. Filed under parameterized/ with the other generate designs, since the question is elaboration rather than the logic.
